annotations.title: A brand's homepage top links, grouped by type

description: A brand's current homepage top links (up to 10) enriched from its catalog and grouped into Products, Categories and Content, in that order. Per link: title, vendor, price + compare-at/on-sale, currency, stock status, URL status (active/inactive), review rating, homepage position, anchor text and last update. A top-level 'comment' flags when pricing and/or stock status are not captured for the domain. Included in RivalSweeper plans (developer API keys: 2 credits, no data = no charge).
